subject: prd/docgate
statement: When a whole-section supersede restates a binding row whose canonical content under FR-38 is unchanged from immediately before the operation, docgate shall preserve that row's exact projected bytes, fold-state presence and value, and source-map-record presence and value, including lineage, and shall not refresh or annotate it.
rationale: a byte-identical restatement must not manufacture a content delta or baseline mismatch merely because a neighboring row required repair
fit_criterion: a mixed-section fixture with one changed lineage-less row, one unchanged lineage-less row, and one unchanged lineage-bearing row refreshes and annotates only the changed row; both unchanged rows remain byte/state/source-map identical, and a wholly byte-identical section restatement stays green under FR-34
